run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-17T23:29:21Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: checkout is genuinely failing: its own spans carry ERROR status and its gRPC PlaceOrder returns code 13, which the frontend surfaces as HTTP 500 to the load generator. The failure starts inside checkout's 'prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart' step at the outbound 'HTTP POST' client span; every sampled failing trace pairs that span with a shipping '/get-quote' server span of only 31-45 microseconds and no downstream call, while a successful trace shows the same POST taking ~36.9 ms and fanning out to shipping 'POST quote' -> quote 'POST /getquote' before the order continues. The exact diagnostic text recorded on checkout/frontend spans is 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400', but no email-service span exists in the failing traces and the only child of the errored POST is shipping '/get-quote', so the mention of the email service does not match the observed call target; email itself shows no ERROR-status span series and appears to be serving 'POST /send_order_confirmation' normally. Failing checkouts also skip the ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and CurrencyService/Convert calls that the successful trace performs before the quote POST. All otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, no OOM/eviction/failed-scheduling events exist for checkout, shipping or email, no NetworkPolicy objects were returned for the namespace, and the only configuration-only rollouts seen are flagd at 23:21:03 and load-generator at 23:53:27 (both identical pod templates/images). The current flagd-config has every fault flag off except loadGeneratorFloodHomepage=100, and no flag references shipping/quote/email request handling. Two candidates remain unresolved: shipping rejecting the quote request with a 400 that it never logs or forwards, or checkout sending a quote request (apparently without items) that shipping's HTTP layer rejects; the root cause is therefore not established.

claims.text: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate fires on sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0 sustained for 1m, severity warning, in rule group GoldenSignalAlerts of the otel-demo alerting-rules file.

checkout ERROR-status span rate for span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rose from 0.0137/s at 23:30:21 to 0.233/s at 23:34:21 and stayed near 0.37-0.52/s to about 23:44:21, while the same operation's STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate stayed around 0.6-1.0/s; it was still 0.267/s at 00:06:21 and 0.220/s at 00:08:21.

Over the hour ending 23:59:21, checkout's ERROR-status span increases are confined to two span names: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (726.4) and HTTP POST (726.4); its oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart and 'orders publish' spans show only STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

The recorded error text on checkout's PlaceOrder spans (otel.status_description) and on frontend's spans (exception.message / grpc.error_message) is exactly 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400', with checkout rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and frontend http.status_code 500.

In failing trace ce7e565b6be4c4bf67f819cd11d442fa (23:33:08) checkout's errored 'HTTP POST' span (553 us) has exactly one downstream span, shipping '/get-quote' (39 us, no status tags); checkout's oteldemo.CartService/GetCart call in the same trace returned rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and the trace contains no email, quote, payment or currency span.

Failing trace 6bda4d8d73478550df2acfc6b1564ab6 (23:33:32) shows the same pattern: checkout 'HTTP POST' error (1726 us) -> shipping '/get-quote' (37 us), preceded by a successful GetCart (rpc.grpc.status_code 0) and no ProductCatalog or Currency spans.

Three further failing traces returned for shipping '/get-quote' spans under 200 us (adb3c50d1d124cff7b898569d2f8feba, 42d7637f2fc4b26edd91b1886cca194d, 7ca0fe45d87843d44530943dfd48166d) all show shipping '/get-quote' durations of 45, 41 and 31 us parented under checkout 'HTTP POST' error spans, while the same traces contain no quote or email spans.

A successful checkout trace in the same window (f7f1b65fab2be85f05e0abffd1916040) shows checkout 'HTTP POST' 36881 us -> shipping '/get-quote' 36421 us -> shipping 'POST quote' 36263 us -> quote 'POST /getquote' 444 us, then checkout 'HTTP POST' 5179 us -> email 'POST /send_order_confirmation' with http.status_code 200; checkout PlaceOrder carries rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

In the hour ending 23:59:21 shipping recorded 2301.8 '/get-quote' spans but only 1575.3 'POST quote' spans, and quote recorded 1571.5 'POST /getquote' spans, i.e. about 726 shipping '/get-quote' spans per hour had no downstream quote call.

The service-level ERROR-span increase query for the hour ending 23:59:21 returned series only for checkout (1452.8), frontend (2733.8), frontend-proxy (42777.8), ad (2.05), fraud-detection (2.05) and recommendation (3.06); it returned no series for shipping, quote, email, cart, payment, currency, product-catalog or accounting.

email's span series in the window (increase over the hour ending 23:59:21) are only POST /send_order_confirmation (1499.0), send_email (1499.0) and sinatra.render_template (2998.0), all with status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET; no ERROR-status email series was returned.
All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restart count 0; checkout-5dccddf8bb-vh65b, shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9 and email-59f69bc6cf-7wqqk all started 2026-11-17T23:19:12-13Z.

The only otel-demo events in the returned window are the load-generator rollout at 23:53:27-28 (Deployment load-generator ScalingReplicaSet 0->1 and 1->0, ReplicaSet load-generator-7d5756fbd9 SuccessfulCreate, Pod load-generator-7d5756fbd9-zzj4z Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started, Pod load-generator-c7cbc4c99-xlnk2 Killing, ReplicaSet load-generator-c7cbc4c99 SuccessfulDelete); all are Normal and none involve checkout, shipping or email.

The ReplicaSet listing shows flagd-7ccc846958 created 2026-11-17T23:21:03Z with replicas 1 beside flagd-c47676d99 created 23:19:14Z with replicas 0, and load-generator-7d5756fbd9 created 23:53:27Z with replicas 1 beside load-generator-c7cbc4c99 created 23:19:12Z with replicas 0; both pairs run the same images (flagd:v0.12.8, demo:2.1.3-load-generator).

The two flagd ReplicaSet pod templates and the two load-generator ReplicaSet pod templates are identical in the fields read (containers, images, commands, all env values, volumes); the load-generator template in both has LOCUST_USERS=350, LOCUST_SPAWN_RATE=10, LOCUST_HOST=http://frontend-proxy:8080.

The flagd-config ConfigMap lists fault flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, each with defaultVariant "off"; the only non-off default is loadGeneratorFloodHomepage ("100"). None of the flags names shipping, quote or a shipping/email request path.

The deployments' container environment holds no fault-injection variables: checkout has SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, shipping has QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, email has EMAIL_PORT=8080, and the only services selecting pods are keyed on each app's own opentelemetry.io/name label (shipping->{opentelemetry.io/name=shipping}, email->{opentelemetry.io/name=email}, quote->{opentelemetry.io/name=quote}).

shipping's pod log stream in 23:33:22-23:33:25 shows continuous quote handling pairs such as 'Requesting quote' 23:33:24.470538Z / 'Sending Quote' 23:33:24.472245Z and 23:33:25.287121Z / 23:33:25.321321Z, and in 23:39:30-23:39:58 the same pattern with 'Tracking ID Created' lines; the shown lines carry no error text.

checkout's pod log stream in 23:31:30-23:33:00 (463 lines in window) contains only successful-order lines such as '[PlaceOrder]', 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent to "bill@example.com"', 'sending to postProcessor' and 'Successful to write message', plus [PlaceOrder] lines with no following step.
frontend-proxy's spans in the hour ending 23:59:21 include 'ingress' ERROR 42295.6 and UNSET 20133.6, and 'router frontend egress' ERROR 482.1 and UNSET 61946.1.

checkout's PlaceOrder failures are produced by the shipping service rejecting the quote request: for every sampled failing trace the errored checkout POST is paired with a shipping '/get-quote' server span of 31-45 us that neither logs, nor returns an error status, nor calls the quote service, and shipping recorded about 726 more '/get-quote' spans than 'POST quote' spans per hour (matching checkout's ~726 hourly PlaceOrder error spans).

The rejected quote requests may be malformed on checkout's side: in the failing traces checkout goes from GetCart straight to the quote POST without the oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert calls that the successful trace performs first, which is consistent with a quote request built from a cart with no items; the request bodies themselves are not observable in the evidence.

The flagd configuration-only rollout at 23:21:03Z (new ReplicaSet flagd-7ccc846958, old flagd-c47676d99 scaled to 0, identical pod template, same flagd:v0.12.8 image) is the mechanism by which some flag setting could have changed shortly before the alert, but none of the fault flags currently in flagd-config refers to shipping, quote or checkout's shipping-quote step, so no specific setting is shown to inject this fault.

The error string mentioning the email service does not mean email is the failing dependency: no email span appears in the failing traces (the errored POST's only child is shipping '/get-quote'), email's only span series in the window are POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email and sinatra.render_template with no ERROR-status series, and the successful trace shows email answering POST /send_order_confirmation with 200.

Pod-level problems on checkout, shipping or email are not the cause: all otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, checkout/shipping/email started at 23:19:12-13Z, and otel-demo events in the window contain no OOMKilled, Evicted, FailedScheduling, BackOff or Unhealthy event for these pods (only the Normal load-generator rollout at 23:53:27).

The load-generator rollout at 23:53:27 is not what caused the errors and did not end them: its old and new ReplicaSet templates are identical (same image, same LOCUST_* env), and checkout's PlaceOrder ERROR rate is still 0.267/s at 00:06:21 and 0.220/s at 00:08:21, after the rollout.

checkout's other dependencies responded normally in the failing traces: oteldemo.CartService/GetCart returned rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and the same trace family shows no payment, currency, product-catalog or email spans at all; no ERROR-status span series was returned for cart, payment, currency, product-catalog, shipping, quote or email in the hour ending 23:59:21.

The quote service was serving traffic at normal speed while checkout failed: quote recorded 1571.5 'POST /getquote' spans and 1571.5 'calculate-quote' spans over the hour ending 23:59:21 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET only, and the successful trace shows a 444 us 'POST /getquote'.

Compare the request body checkout sends to http://shipping:8080/get-quote on failing versus succeeding attempts (e.g., with checkout's HTTP client logging the payload and response body) to determine whether the 400 is caused by an empty-item cart or by a shipping-side validation rule; also check why the checkout error text names the email service for a call whose span child is shipping '/get-quote'.

Review the shipping service's /get-quote handler and its Rack/JSON parsing path for requests rejected before the 'Requesting quote' log line, since those requests return within 31-45 us without reaching the quote service; enabling request-level error logging there would make the cause observable.

gaps: The request bodies and HTTP response codes of checkout's '/get-quote' POST are not exposed by the trace projection (only status tags are shown), so whether shipping's 400 is caused by a malformed/empty checkout payload or by a shipping-side rule is unknown.

Filtered log queries for error keywords ('error|fail|400|exception') on the checkout pod (23:20:00-23:35:00) and the shipping pod (23:20:00-23:40:00) returned no matching lines (no_data views), so an absence of error log lines is not established; the shipping pod exposed only successful 'Requesting quote'/'Sending Quote' pairs.

The flagd Deployment was rolled out config-only at 2026-11-17T23:21:03Z with an identical pod template; what changed in that rollout and which flag values flagd was serving at 23:29 could not be read (flagd pod logs returned 0 lines for 23:20-23:40, and flagd-ui writes to a pod-local emptyDir), so no fault setting can be tied to the alert time.

Earliest sample of traces_span_metrics_calls_total in this run's window is 2026-11-17T23:29:21Z, so no baseline exists before the alert; whether this failure began at 23:29 or existed since the 23:19:12Z deployment cannot be determined.
The networkpolicies query for namespace otel-demo returned an empty object list; whether any policy affects checkout-to-shipping traffic is therefore unchecked rather than ruled out.

frontend-proxy 'ingress' spans carry ERROR status on 42295.6 of 62129 spans in the hour ending 23:59:21, but their HTTP status codes are not visible in the projection; whether this is unrelated background (e.g., 4xx on static assets) or connected to checkout's failures is unverified.

Span counters are not unique request counts and the trace view is a sample (traces_search_by_tag results were limited and some requests were too large to return whole), so the exact proportion of failing checkouts is derived from span counters only.
Change history is not an available integration in this run (listed as not_integrated), and Kubernetes events are only retained from 23:34:01 onward, so changes before that time are unobserved.
next_steps: Inspect checkout's quote-request construction and serialization for orders whose cart comes back empty, and capture the exact payload plus shipping's response body for one failing request.
Inspect the shipping service's /get-quote validation and Rack/JSON parse error handling, and add request logging for rejected requests.
Check the history of the load-generator traffic scenarios and whether empty-cart checkouts are an intended part of user_checkout_single/user_checkout_multi.
Verify which flagd flag values were in effect at 2026-11-17T23:29:21Z (e.g., via flagd-ui history) and whether any fault flag relevant to checkout/shipping was enabled and later disabled.

content:
groups:
- interval: 1m
  name: ClusterAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: FailedPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in failed state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is above
        0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by(namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo", phase="Failed"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PendingPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in pending state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} above
        0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by(namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo", phase="Pending"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: CrashLoopBackOffPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in CrashLoopBackOff state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace
        }} above 0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="otel-demo",reason="CrashLoopBackOff"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
- interval: 1m
  name: GoldenSignalAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: RequestLatency
    annotations:
      description: 'Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{
        $labels.namespace }} is above 1500ms (current: {{ $value }}s)'
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name!~"flagd|load-generator|accounting|fraud-detection"}[2m])))
      > 1500
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: RequestLatencyProcessor
    annotations:
      description: 'Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{
        $labels.namespace }} is above 15000ms (current: {{ $value }}s)'
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"accounting|fraud-detection"}[2m])))
      > 15000
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: RequestErrorRate
    annotations:
      description: 'Request error rate in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace
        {{ $labels.namespace }} is above 0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR",
      service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
- interval: 1m
  name: GoodputAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: NoRequestsDetected
    annotations:
      description: Service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{ $labels.namespace
        }} has 0 requests
    expr: sum by (service_name, namespace) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name!~"flagd|load-generator",
      namespace="otel-demo", status_code=~"STATUS_CODE_UNSET|STATUS_CODE_OK"}[2m]))
      == 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
- interval: 1m
  name: KafkaAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: KafkaConnectionClosureRate
    annotations:
      description: 'Job {{ $labels.job }} has a closure rate above 0 (current: {{
        $value }})'
    expr: sum by (job) (kafka_consumer_connection_close_rate) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
